messages:
maya-partner-manager: Quick sync — we need to align on three items before we can mark the AWS/GCP/Azure listing ready for publisher onboarding: (1) rotate publisher API keys + publish new key instructions, (2) final brand assets and icon sizes, (3) trial entitlement term (14 vs 30 days).
ethan-legal: +1. Legal still needs the marketplace clause added to the EULA and a short data residency blurb. Can someone drop the latest EULA draft here?
sam-devex: I have the EULA draft in Drive, link: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace/eula-draft-v3 — will paste the specific clause we need. Also we need hero image (1200x628) and square icon (512x512) — marketplace requires PNGs and a transparent SVG if possible.
jessica-ops: For Dedicated listings we also need AMI/VM image IDs per region and a short install note. Can the infra team provide the AMI mapping? Without that we can't enable region visibility.
ron-sales: Heads up — a couple of partners asked about trial length. Sales prefers 30 days for co-sell motion, but marketplace product listing often uses 14 to reduce fraud.
maya-partner-manager: Suggest we standardize to 14 for public marketplace and offer a 30-day trial via partner sales/entitlement flow. That keeps listing consistent and allows exceptions. Thoughts?
ethan-legal: Legal leans 14 too — fewer compliance flags. If we do exceptions, need an approval flow and templated addendum.
olga-privacy: Also flag: for EU customers we need to call out subprocessor list and a short note on logs retention in the listing copy. I'll share the approved blurb.
sam-devex: Actionable checklist I'm taking:
```
- upload hero (1200x628) + icon (512x512 + svg)
- asset manifest: name, description (<= 400 chars), categories, marketing tags
- SKU ids: market_sku_public, market_sku_enterprise
- packaging YAML for trial entitlement mapping
```
I'll attach a sample packaging YAML here in thread.
sam-devex: ```yaml
marketplace:
  sku: "redwood-inference-hosted"
  plans:
    - id: "public-trial"
      display_name: "14-day trial"
      entitlements:
        - tokens: 100000
        - support: "community"
    - id: "enterprise-commit"
      display_name: "Enterprise"
      entitlements:
        - tokens: 2000000
        - support: "standard"
```
maya-partner-manager: Perfect. Ethan — can you confirm legal copy for the addendum and whether we should include the trial duration language in the listing?
ethan-legal: Confirming: include trial duration language as "14-day evaluation" in the public listing. Addendum template for 30-day exceptions: I will drop a redline by EOD.
pubbot: Publisher API key rotation scheduled: old key will be deprecated in 7 days. New key: follow https://console.redwood.ai/publisher/keys -> Rotate -> Distribute.
jessica-ops: Ops note: when rotating keys, we need at least 48h overlap with the old key in the publisher portal to avoid marketplace webhook dropouts. Call out the rollout window in the partner email.
ron-sales: I'll draft the partner-facing note and include troubleshooting steps. Want to avoid any outage during the catalog refresh.
maya-partner-manager: Who can produce the final asset bundle (zipped, manifest.json) for ingestion to AWS/GCP/Azure? Deadline: end of next Tue.
sam-devex: I'll package assets and produce manifest.json. Will need hero + icons from marketing.
olga-privacy: I'll review the listing copy for privacy flags before ingestion.
ethan-legal: Once I post the addendum redline, can we get a quick legal + partnerships signoff by Wed?
maya-partner-manager: Yes — planning a 30-min sync Wed 09:30 PT to confirm signoffs. Agenda: EULA addendum, asset bundle, API key rotation schedule, AMI region map, trial exception workflow.
ron-sales: :thumbsup: I'll be there.
pubbot: Artifact uploaded: /artifacts/marketplace/3345678901/asset-bundle-preview.zip
sam-devex: I see the preview. Quick checklist before final upload:
- image alt text for accessibility
- localized short description (en, fr, de) — marketing can help
- owner contact email field set to partnerships@redwood.ai
maya-partner-manager: Great — assigning owners: Sam for asset bundle, Ethan for legal addendum, Olga for privacy review, Jessica for ops readiness, Ron for partner comms. I'll send calendar invite.
jessica-ops: Ops will schedule key rotation for next Friday 02:00 PT with 48h overlap window. I'll post the runbook in #eng-oncall once scheduled.
ethan-legal: Redline posted: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketplace/eula-addendum-redline-v1 — please review by EOD Tue.
maya-partner-manager: Thanks everyone. If there are no blockers, I'll mark the onboarding ticket as "ready for ingestion" after Wed sync. :rocket:
ron-sales: quick Q — do we need a separate SKU for BYOC (bring-your-own-cloud) vs Hosted?
sam-devex: Yes please. We'll map two SKUs in manifest: redwood-inference-hosted and redwood-inference-byoc. BYOC needs a short note about network setup and support SLA.
maya-partner-manager: Noted. Closing loop: target ingest to AWS/GCP/Azure sandboxes on Thu next week, production listing the week after if all signoffs complete.
olga-privacy: I'll run the privacy checklist and reply in-thread with any required copy changes.
ethan-legal: all good from legal for the 14-day language.
maya-partner-manager: End of thread — thanks. Followups in Wed sync.
